### The Verse and the Claim

> Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.  
> — John 5:25 (MSB)  
> [https://lampas.allmymind.org/#/?ref=John.5.25](https://lampas.allmymind.org/#/?ref=John.5.25)

The [report of the service](https://nak-sued.de/db/14239) says the departed could hear the voice of Jesus Christ.[^1]

### Where I Stand

No one can stand when the Lord appears.[^2] But those who have truly repented and believe in Him will be saved at that judgment.[^3]

[^1]: [John 5:1-15](https://lampas.allmymind.org/#/?ref=John.5.1-15).

[^2]: [Malachi 3:2](https://lampas.allmymind.org/#/?ref=Mal.3.2); [Revelation 6:17](https://lampas.allmymind.org/#/?ref=Rev.6.17).

[^3]: [Acts 3:19](https://lampas.allmymind.org/#/?ref=Acts.3.19); [Romans 8:1](https://lampas.allmymind.org/#/?ref=Rom.8.1).
